title: Weekly Product Sync
summary: Pak Budi wants three things done before the investor demo on 5 December: a three-tier pricing page (Basic, Pro, Enterprise) with monthly and yearly prices, the late verification-email bug in onboarding fixed with a provider comparison if the provider is at fault, and a demo script covering those two flows. The demo will show nothing else. The FAQ update for the new tiers has no owner yet.

decisions.text: Investor demo on 5 Dec shows only the new pricing page and the fixed onboarding; no new features.

tasks.task: Redesign the pricing page with three tiers (Basic, Pro, Enterprise)
what_is_needed: Three tiers: Basic (the old single plan), Pro, Enterprise
Use the new brand colours from the Figma file Sari shared last week
Show monthly and yearly prices, with the yearly discount
Free plan is kept but NOT shown on the pricing page; it stays in the signup flow
Ready for review before the investor demo
tasks.quote: Rina, can you redesign the pricing page with the three tiers? Use the new brand colours from the Figma file Sari shared last week, and show both monthly and yearly prices with the yearly discount.

tasks.task: Investigate the verification-email queue issue and fix it; if the provider is the cause, prepare a comparison of two alternative providers with pricing
tasks.deadline: Fix: ASAP. Provider comparison: Wednesday 26 Nov
what_is_needed: Find the root cause of late/missing verification emails (9 of 14 bug reports this week)
If the provider is at fault: compare two alternatives including pricing
Sari helps with testing once the fix is ready
tasks.quote: Dion, I need you to look at the email queue this week. Find the root cause, and if it is the provider, get me a comparison of two alternatives with pricing.

tasks.task: Test the verification-email fix once Dion has it ready
tasks.quote: Yes, Sari helps with testing once the fix is ready.

tasks.task: Write the investor demo script covering the pricing page and onboarding flows
what_is_needed: Two flows only: new pricing page and fixed onboarding
tasks.quote: Yes please, Sari, a demo script with the two flows, send me a draft by Monday.

tasks.task: Update the FAQ page for the new pricing tiers
what_is_needed: FAQ must reflect the three tiers
tasks.quote: And someone needs to update the FAQ page for the new tiers, we'll figure out who later.
tasks.confidence_note: Pak Budi said 'we'll figure out who later'; Rina offered conditionally and he replied 'let's see'. Confirm the owner.

qa.question: So we drop the single plan completely?
qa.answer: Yes, the single plan becomes Basic.

qa.question: Do we keep the free plan?
qa.answer: Keep it, but do not show it on the pricing page; it stays on the signup flow only.

qa.question: When do you need the pricing page?
qa.answer: Friday the 28th, to review before the demo.

qa.question: How many onboarding bug reports this week?
qa.answer: Fourteen; nine are the same late/missing verification email issue.

qa.question: Can I pull Sari in for testing?
qa.answer: Yes, once the fix is ready.

qa.question: What is the deadline for the provider comparison?
qa.answer: Next Wednesday; the fix itself as soon as possible.

qa.question: Should I prepare the demo script?
qa.answer: Yes, two flows, draft by Monday.

exchanges.speaker: Rina
